draft.title: The five-sector circular flow model
card: The circular flow model shows how money moves around the economy between five sectors: households, businesses, government, financial institutions and the overseas sector.
Households supply labour and other resources to businesses and receive income. They spend on goods and services, which becomes revenue for businesses.
Some flows leave the circular flow. These are saving (to financial institutions), taxes (to government) and imports (to the overseas sector). Each is a leakage.
Other flows enter the circular flow. These are borrowing for investment (from financial institutions), government spending and exports (from the overseas sector). Each is an injection.
draft.remember: Leakages take money out of the flow. Injections put money back in.

a.q: Which of these is a leakage from the circular flow?
opts: A household saves part of its income in a bank
A business sells goods to an overseas buyer
A government builds a new road
A business borrows from a bank to buy machinery
a.why: Saving takes income out of the flow of spending and passes it to financial institutions. The overseas sale is an export, which is an injection. Government spending and borrowing for investment are also injections.
a.clue: Which one takes money out of spending on goods and services?

b.q: Mia runs a bakery in Geelong. She buys a new oven with a loan from a bank. How does this appear in the circular flow?
opts: An injection, from financial institutions to businesses
A leakage, from businesses to financial institutions
An injection, from households to businesses
A leakage, from businesses to the overseas sector
b.why: Borrowing for investment moves money from financial institutions into business spending, so it is an injection. It is not a leakage, because the money is added to the flow. Repaying the loan later is a separate flow.
b.clue: Which sector supplies the money, and does it enter or leave the flow?

a.best: A household saves part of its income in a bank

b.best: An injection, from financial institutions to businesses
